name: shopping-copilot
description: A unified monorepo for shopping assistant with Chrome extension, backend server, and MCP server

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:extension" "npm run dev:mcp"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/extension
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/extension && npm run type-check --workspace=apps/mcp-server
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=apps/extension && npm run clean --workspaces --if-present

author: Shopping Copilot Team
